revisions.title: Guarding the question from the digression
revisions.body: At the close of this long detour, Socrates names its danger: arguments that burst in may leave the governing question—what knowledge is—unexamined. I hear his refusal to pursue Parmenides here as a choice about scope, not a verdict on Parmenides. The conversation must return to Theaetetus and try the maieutic examination of what he is “pregnant” with about knowledge.
